reference.exact_bound_explanation: The unchanged baseline bound is 40x+30y = 20(x+y)+10(2x+y) <= 2600, attained by (20,60), which also meets the synthetic minima (10,10). In the shortage scenario, those minima imply x+y>=20 while Labor A requires x+y<=5, so the stated exact constraints are incompatible. Reset restores the baseline capacities and objective 2600. These independently written arithmetic references are specific to the synthetic input and do not change runtime proof categories.
